scripts:
create path (sling:OrderedFolder) /content
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/comments
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/deleted
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/searches
create path (sling:Folder) /var/studio/kept
create path (sling:Folder) /var/workflow/instances
create service user studio-siterail-service
set ACL for studio-siterail-service
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/comments
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/deleted
    allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/studio/searches
    allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:nodeTypeManagement on /var/studio/kept
    allow jcr:read on /var/workflow
    allow jcr:read,jcr:versionManagement on /jcr:system/jcr:versionStorage
    allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:versionManagement,jcr:nodeTypeManagement on /content
end
